fields.description: Weeks this row takes. A stage that has steps under it is the sum of those steps and is worked out, not typed.
fields.label: Weeks

fields.description: Material lost at this stage. Applied in sequence, so 10% here and 10% next is 81% surviving, not 80%.
fields.label: Loss %

fields.description: A stage the material can be bought at. More than one may be ticked -- the plan chooses where to enter the route.
fields.label: Bought at this stage

fields.description: Order to arrival, when bought at this stage.
fields.label: Supplier Lead (weeks)

fields.description: What one unit costs here. A plantlet, a rooted plant and a tuber are different money.
fields.label: Rate per unit

fields.description: Units out per unit in. 1 for a stage that carries material through; a stage that multiplies -- motherstock, a sprouted tuber -- is what one unit yields. A step never multiplies: if it did, it would be a stage.
fields.label: Yields per unit

fields.description: How many times material may go round at this stage -- motherstock generations, tuber divisions. 0 means it does not recycle.
fields.label: Max Cycles

fields.description: The item material is held as at this stage. What lets stock already on hand -- roots in store, motherstock standing, tubers in the cold room -- be counted against what a plan needs instead of being bought again.
fields.label: Item

fields.description: Material handed back when the crop is lifted -- tubers off a dahlia clump, roots off an eryngium. Nets off next season's requirement.
fields.label: Returns per plant at lift
